record_fields.raw_score: number|null; observed Student Evidence Bloom L1-L6, never an AI increment
record_fields.reliability: number in [0,1]; deterministic support weight, not a probability
record_fields.adjusted_score: number|null; raw_score multiplied by reliability for a record
record_fields.threshold: 0.75 record reliability threshold used for DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_STRUCTURAL_SUPPORT vs LOW_SUPPORT
record_fields.coverage: effective_weight / N; N must be shown and is 70 for current development slice

aggregate_fields.adjusted_score: sum(weight*raw_score) / sum(weight), null if zero support
aggregate_fields.decision: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_STRUCTURAL_SUPPORT only when aggregate support is defined; otherwise NO_EFFECTIVE_EVIDENCE
